title: Setting Circle Benefit Credit Against a Charge the Member Holds
content:
## The request this schedule answers

A member holding a charge and asking for granted Circle benefit credit to be put against it is dealt with
under this schedule. What it governs is the money set against that one charge from the benefit credit
standing on a Northbeam Circle Membership.

## When the amount set against a charge is worked out

The credit set against a charge is worked out only after the ledger carries, for the membership year
in which that charge falls, a grant of the very named benefit that charge's kind calls for.

## What the booking does to the record

The membership ledger gains a redemption entry carrying the named benefit, the charge reference the credit
was spent against and the credit money, and the unspent benefit credit shown on the membership drops by that
money. The member sees the credit taken off their side of that charge and the remaining benefit credit on
the membership.

## How the credit is set against the charge

`apply_benefit_credit_8295b346` is the desk's own tool: it is unlocked and then called by the agent handling
the membership.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| membership_id | The reference number of the Circle membership whose credit is being spent | An identifier, read from the membership record returned when the membership is looked up |
| benefit_code | Which named Circle benefit is being spent | Exactly one of the values below |
| redemption_ref | The reference of the charge the credit is being spent against | Taken from the way the customer reads it out on the call and copied character for character, keeping their wording, digits, letter case and punctuation, with nothing translated, tidied, shortened, added or dropped |
| credit_applied_usd | The benefit credit money set against that charge | USD to 2 decimal places, a positive amount rounded half to even at the cent, stored at exactly that precision, with no unit symbol passed |

The complete set of values `benefit_code` takes: `anniversary_reward`, the yearly reward credit that goes
with the membership year itself; `install_credit`, the credit that goes toward installation labour;
`delivery_credit`, the credit that goes toward a delivery charge; `service_credit`, the credit that goes
toward bench or on-site repair labour; `haul_away_credit`, the credit that goes toward taking an old item
away; `business_consultation_credit`, the credit that goes toward a business consultation on a business
tier.

## What comes back

A confirmation line naming the membership, the named benefit spent, the charge reference the credit was set
against, the credit money taken off and the reference number of the new redemption entry; the presence of
that redemption entry reference is what marks the call as completed.
